title: Example Session Workbook & Tactical Playbook
player_goal: Protect valuable loot and extract; win only forced close threats.

session_summary.narrative: This sanitized example shows how a coaching run becomes a compact player workbook. Replace all fields with validated local-session evidence before rendering.

strengths.title: Reset discipline
strengths.evidence: The player breaks a visible firing lane before repairing damage.
strengths.why_keep: It preserves a later decision instead of feeding the original angle.

priorities.title: Information changes the route
priorities.pattern: A visible exposure warning is followed by continued direct travel.
priorities.rule: Break to visible cover before committing to the duel.

lessons.title: A warning must change the route
observed: An exposure warning is visible before first contact.
inferred: Continuing straight increases the chance of taking the first open fight.
unknown: The source does not prove the scan origin or enemy count.
lessons.decision_point: The player continued forward after the warning instead of using the visible cover break.

alternative.action: Break to the visible wall edge, stop sprinting, and identify one firing lane before returning fire.
alternative.tradeoff: This gives up a few seconds of tempo.
alternative.likely_benefit: It could preserve a better first shot and a reset option.

drill.action: Name one visible cover break before shooting.
drill.success_condition: The player stops direct travel before the first shot in three forced contacts.

lessons.reflection_prompt: Which visible object was the nearest cover break, and what trade-off did it create?

next_session_rules.action: Cover first, then choose the duel or rotate.

practice_plan.name: Three-second security check
practice_plan.instruction: After a kill, identify the last firing lane and nearest entrance before opening a body or inventory screen.
practice_plan.measurement: Complete this on the next three loot opportunities.

evidence_limits: This is a sanitized example; it does not contain a real recording or real-session screenshot.
Unseen enemy intent and hidden geometry remain UNKNOWN.
